posted_text:
🔑 MA H5554 — Great Barrington Residents Could Sit on Housing Authority Board

This bill would allow a single resident of Sheffield to serve as a member of the Great Barrington Housing Authority board.

Currently, the board is appointed, but this change would allow a Sheffield resident to be either appointed or elected to the board, subject to the usual rules around board membership outlined in Chapter 121B of the General Laws.

This means a Sheffield resident could have a direct voice in decisions about the Housing Authority.

Aug. 6, 2026: Bill reported favorably by committee and referred to the committee on House Steering, Policy and Scheduling.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://malegislature.gov/Bills/194/H5554
